metadata.scope: Official HRM current-fiscal budget evidence for the ratified 2026/27 municipal budget.
metadata.principle: The March 25 staff package is the financial table source; the March 31 Regional Council record is separate approval evidence. A budget authorization is not evidence of a payment, invoice, commitment or final cost.

budget_source.name: Proposed 2026/27 Budget — final post-BAL staff package
budget_source.coverage: March 25, 2026 final Budget Committee package containing the budget after business-unit presentations and Budget Adjustment List deliberations.
budget_source.ingestion: Official eSCRIBE PDF service-area budget tables

approval_source.name: Regional Council — Ratification from Budget Committee, Proposed 2026/27 Budget
approval_source.approval_text: Regional Council adopted the Resolution for Approval of Operating Budgets, Capital Plan and Tax Rates for Fiscal 2026/27 as set out in Schedule 1 of the March 25, 2026 staff report.
approval_source.interpretation_boundary: Council approval establishes budget authority. It does not establish that an authorized amount was spent or paid.
